subject: Shinyapps.io authentication slows down R Shiny App and only works on certain browsers

messages.author: 0515ad21c84e17f6
messages.subject: Shinyapps.io authentication slows down R Shiny App and only works on certain browsers
parts:
Shinyapps.io Professional Private Hosted App is taking a long time to load on Chrome, Firefox, and IE, but loads quickly on Safari. But we have no issues with our other apps that set to public (instead of private).

Since this works on one browser but not the others, and since this only happens when the app is set to private (and requires authentication), it sounds like this is a shinyapps.io authentication issue.

Has anyone else had this problem? If so, how did you resolve it?

Any other ideas on how to fix it?
